subject: greater bulldog bat
title: This Bat Hunts Fish by Listening to Ripples

scenes.text: This bat hunts fish. In the dark. Without seeing a thing.
It's the greater bulldog bat, a bat of about sixty grams, flying a few inches above the water.
It chirps and listens for the tiny ripples a fish makes at the surface.
Then it swoops down, and rakes the water with huge feet armed with hooked claws.
Its feet are up to nearly four times bigger than a normal bat's. It can catch fish about four inches long.
A ripple on the water is all it needs to find dinner.

description:
This bat hunts fish in the dark without seeing a thing.
The greater bulldog bat echolocates ripples on the water, then rakes its giant clawed feet through the surface.
Would you trust your ears that much?
first_comment: A bat that fishes by ear. Which animal has the strangest way of hunting?
